title: Free field realizations of $N=1$ SUSY affine vertex algebras
summary: We construct Wakimoto-type free field realizations of $N=1$ SUSY affine vertex algebras associated with basic classical Lie superalgebras. Using the superfield formalism, we obtain a SUSY analogue of the Wakimoto realization in terms of $βγ$--$bc$ systems and boson--fermion systems (or SUSY Heisenberg vertex algebras). We also construct screening operators for the free field realizations. A distinctive feature of the SUSY setting is that, unlike the ordinary Wakimoto realization, the injectivity of the free field homomorphism depends on the level.
